MEMORANDUM

To: Board of [AUTHORITY]
Re: Taxable revenue bond and PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT] in [COUNTY]

Purpose. Staff requests board direction on a taxable revenue bond funding $12,000,000 of project cost for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT] in [COUNTY], paired with a payment-in-lieu-of-taxes (PILOT) agreement.

Bond structure. Par is $12,245,000, grossed up so that 2.0% issuance costs are paid from proceeds, then rounded up to the next $5,000. The rate is 4.50% fixed over 20 years. Months 1-24 are interest-only at $45,918.75 per month. Months 25-240 carry level principal and interest payments of $82,815.94 per month. Total interest over the term is $6,745,293. Projected net operating income of $1,500,000 per year covers amortizing debt service 1.51 times.

PILOT. Taxable property comprises $18,000,000 of real property and equipment that starts at $9,000,000 and declines 10% of original cost annually to a 20% floor. The assessment ratio is 40%, with millage of 27.9 mills in years 1-5 and 28.5 mills thereafter. Abatement is 100% in year 1, falling 10 points per year to 10% in year 10. The year 6 PILOT payment is $123,120. Total abated tax over years 1-10 is $1,447,740, with a present value of $1,210,576 at 5.0 percent, or $9,651.60 per job across 150 jobs at $52,000.

Staff will return with a resolution for the board's consideration.
